entities.summary: Estelle Ceulemans is a Belgian politician and trade unionist from the Socialist Party. She was general secretary of the FGTB Brussels from 2018 to 2024. She was elected Member of the European Parliament (MEP) for the French-speaking electoral college in the 2024 European Parliament election.
